Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the WebSurfer retrieved search results that correctly identified Gay Byrne as the host of "For One Night Only" (an Irish show). However, the WebSurfer (or the Planner relying on it) incorrectly concluded that Gay Byrne was best known for hosting "The Late Show" which ran from 1962 to 1999. Gay Byrne is actually best known for hosting "The Late Late Show" (Irish version), which ran from 1962 to 1999. The error lies in the hallucination of the show's title ("The Late Show" vs "The Late Late Show") and the failure to verify the specific title associated with the 1962–1999 run date, leading to the wrong final answer. While the Planner made the logical leap, the WebSurfer provided the unverified factual data (the show title) that led to the error.
